integrity: Direct parametrization and inclusion-exclusion proof; independent exact enumeration on grids of sizes 1,3,4,6 and an exact nine-cell subset-law calculation. No independent mathematical audit.
limitations: All-dimensional proof applies to positive labeled side lengths; the Poisson limit requires both sides to diverge. No result about all cycle lengths, joint cycle profiles, or arbitrary Rees matrix semigroups. An equivalent unindexed fixed-point formula could exist.
title: Exact fixed-point laws for complete mappings of rectangular bands
